messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a quick wash (soft cloth, mild cleaner) and tune it to standard tuning (E‑A‑D‑G‑B‑E). | A well‑presented, properly tuned instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take Quality Photos** | • Use natural light (avoid harsh flash).
• Capture front, back, side, headstock, strings, and any visible wear or damage.
• Include a reference object (e.g., a coin or ruler) for scale. | High‑resolution images reduce buyer hesitation and help set realistic expectations. | | **3. Write a Detailed Description** | • Brand, model, year, wood type, finish, serial number.
• Condition notes (scratches, cracks, repairs).
• Accessories included (case, strap, picks).
• Why you’re selling (upgrade, moved, etc.). | Transparency builds trust and reduces post‑sale disputes. | | **4. Research Pricing** | • Check completed listings on eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music stores.
• Compare similar models, age, and condition.
• Decide on a “list” price slightly above your target sale price to allow room for negotiation. | Accurate pricing attracts serious buyers and speeds up the sale. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Online Marketplaces** – eBay, Reverb, Etsy (for vintage), Amazon (if you have a seller account).
• **Local Classifieds** – Craigslist, Gumtree, Kijiji.
• **Social Media** – Facebook Marketplace, Instagram (use reels or stories).
• **Consignment Shops** – Local music stores or specialty consignment shops.
• **Community Boards** – University bulletin boards, community centers. | Multiple platforms increase visibility; choose those most popular in your area. | | **6. Set Up Shipping (if needed)** | • Use a sturdy, padded case or a custom guitar box.
• Get a reliable courier (USPS, UPS, FedEx) and consider insurance.
• Offer both “buyer pays” and “seller pays” options depending on your preference. | Proper packaging protects the instrument and gives buyers confidence. | | **7. Communicate Promptly** | • Respond to inquiries within 24 hrs.
• Be honest about any issues.
• Offer to meet in person if possible (public place, daylight). | Quick, courteous communication builds rapport and can lead to faster sales. | | **8. Finalize the Sale** | • Agree on payment method (PayPal, Venmo, cash, bank transfer).
• Provide a simple receipt or invoice.
• If shipping, track the package and share tracking info with the buyer. | Clear paperwork protects both parties and ensures smooth transaction completion. | ### Quick Tips & Common Pitfalls | Tip | Explanation | |-----|-------------| | **Avoid “as‑is” without explanation** | Buyers may balk if they think hidden defects will surface later. | | **Don’t overprice** | Even a great guitar can sit unsold for months if priced too high. | | **Use “free pickup” to attract local buyers** | Many people prefer to inspect before buying; offering free pickup can boost interest. | | **Check local regulations** | Some cities require a business license for selling used goods online. | | **Beware of scams** | Never accept checks from unknown buyers; use secure payment methods. | ### Sample Listing Template ``` Title: 2010 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition – Free Pickup Description: - Brand/Model: Yamaha FG800 - Year: 2010 - Wood: Spruce top, mahogany back & sides - Finish: Natural gloss - Serial #: 12345678 - Condition: Minor scratches on the back, no cracks, fully functional - Included: Original case, strap, picks, cleaning cloth - Reason for selling: Upgrading to a 12‑string Price: $350 (Negotiable) Photos: [Attach 5–7 clear images] Contact: DM me or email example@email.com. Available for pickup Monday–Friday 9am–5pm. Shipping available for $30 (insured). ``` Feel free to adapt this template to match your guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
